laws.title: Believe in God
laws.summary: Affirm the existence and sovereignty of God; the USofC makes the affirmation an annual sworn filing.

laws.title: Acknowledge divine unity
laws.summary: Confess that God is one (the Shema); recited to open every school day and legislative session.

laws.title: Love God
laws.summary: Love God with all heart, soul, and might; operationalized as measurable devotion metrics.

laws.title: Fear God
laws.summary: Maintain reverent fear of God; cited in every sentencing colloquy.

laws.title: Sanctify God's name
laws.summary: Public conduct must sanctify the Name; the affirmative twin of the blasphemy ban.

laws.title: Do not profane God's name
laws.summary: No act or speech that profanes the Name; the blasphemy statute's foundation.

laws.title: Do not test God
laws.summary: Do not put God to the test as at Massah; construed to ban demanding miracles of state chaplains.

laws.title: Imitate God's ways
laws.summary: Walk in God's ways; the civic virtue curriculum's charter text.

laws.title: Cleave to the wise
laws.summary: Attach yourself to God (read: to his scholars); basis of mandatory clergy mentorship.

laws.title: Swear by God's name only
laws.summary: Lawful oaths invoke the Name alone; all court oaths are covenant affirmations.

laws.title: Do not take the Name in vain
laws.summary: No vain or false invocation of the Name; see deep record exo-020-007.

laws.title: Do not swear falsely
laws.summary: No false oaths by the Name; perjury prosecuted as blasphemy.

laws.title: Do not break a vow
laws.summary: Whatever proceeds from your mouth you must do; the Vow Registry enforces specific performance.

laws.title: Fulfill vows promptly
laws.summary: Delay in paying a vow is sin; vows accrue statutory interest to the Temple fund.

laws.title: Pray to God
laws.summary: Serve God (construed as prayer); daily observance logged via congregation attendance.

laws.title: Read the Shema morning and evening
laws.summary: Recite the words when you lie down and rise up; broadcast at 6am and 9pm on all licensed media.

laws.title: Bind the words as a sign (tefillin/frontlets)
laws.summary: Bind the law on hand and forehead; survives as the Covenant Lapel Seal, mandatory for officials.

laws.title: Write the words on doorposts (mezuzah)
laws.summary: Inscribe the law on doorposts and gates; every dwelling carries a certified Doorpost Plaque.

laws.title: Wear fringes on garments
laws.summary: Tassels on garment corners as reminders; survives in official and clerical dress codes.

laws.title: Assemble the people to hear the law
laws.summary: Periodic national assembly to hear the law read; now the televised Septennial Reading.

laws.title: Write a copy of the law (the king's copy)
laws.summary: The sovereign writes and keeps a personal copy of the law; each President hand-copies Deuteronomy on live broadcast.

laws.title: Teach the law to your children
laws.summary: Diligent instruction of children; homeschool and NDS curricula audited for scripture density.

laws.title: Bless God after eating
laws.summary: When you have eaten and are full, bless the LORD; restaurant grace is a posted-compliance item.

laws.title: Do not add to the commandments
laws.summary: Add nothing to the word; the clause every new regulation must recite before adding to the word.

laws.title: Do not subtract from the commandments
laws.summary: Diminish nothing from the word; the repeal-proofing clause of the whole Code.

laws.title: No other gods
laws.summary: Exclusive allegiance; see deep record exo-020-003.

laws.title: Do not make idols
laws.summary: No graven images; see deep record exo-020-004.

laws.title: Do not bow to idols
laws.summary: No prostration to images; see deep record exo-020-005.

laws.title: Do not worship idols by their rites
laws.summary: No serving idols in the manner their cults prescribe.

laws.title: Do not make gods of metal
laws.summary: No molten gods; the Precious Metals Devotional Use Act.

laws.title: Do not make idols for others
laws.summary: Manufacturing idols for third parties is equally criminal; the export-model loophole closed.

laws.title: Do not turn to idols
laws.summary: Do not so much as turn your attention to idols; the browsing-history statute.

laws.title: Do not erect a sacred pillar
laws.summary: No standing stones for worship; monument permitting runs through OIP.

laws.title: Do not plant a tree as an Asherah
laws.summary: No cult trees beside the altar; landscaping near licensed sanctuaries is regulated.

laws.title: Do not make figured stones to bow on
laws.summary: No carved kneeling-stones; decorative pavers near altars require certification.

laws.title: Destroy idolatry and its appurtenances
laws.summary: Demolish the places of foreign worship; the Iconoclasm Division's charter.

laws.title: Do not covet idol ornaments
laws.summary: Do not take the silver or gold on destroyed idols; seized cult assets must be destroyed, not auctioned — the least-obeyed sentence in the Code.

laws.title: Do not bring an abomination into your house
laws.summary: No idolatrous object in a dwelling; the household contraband schedule.

laws.title: Do not follow the statutes of the nations
laws.summary: Do not walk in the customs of the nations; the Foreign Customs Review Board rules on imported holidays.

laws.title: Do not imitate pagan dress and custom
laws.summary: Do not do as Egypt and Canaan; enforced as the Modest and Distinct Apparel Guidelines.

laws.title: Do not mention the names of other gods
laws.summary: Make no mention of other gods' names; weekday names (Thor's day, Woden's day) were officially renumbered — nobody uses the new names.

laws.title: Do not entice others to idolatry
laws.summary: Enticement to foreign worship is capital, even by a brother or spouse; the informant-in-the-family statute.

laws.title: Show the enticer no pity; expose him
laws.summary: Do not spare or shield the enticer; failure to report is itself an offense.

laws.title: Do not love or heed the enticer
laws.summary: Affection for the enticer is legally aggravating, not mitigating.

laws.title: Investigate an accused idolatrous city
laws.summary: Inquire diligently before destroying an apostate city; the regime's proudest due-process clause, attached to its worst statute.

laws.title: Burn the apostate city; rebuild never
laws.summary: The condemned city is burned entire and never rebuilt; the statute exists, invoked once, records sealed.

laws.title: Retain nothing of the condemned city
laws.summary: No spoil may cleave to your hand from the herem city.

laws.title: Do not prophesy in the name of other gods
laws.summary: Speaking for foreign gods is capital prophecy fraud.

laws.title: Do not listen to the false prophet
laws.summary: Do not heed signs and wonders offered against the covenant; miracle claims require SSC licensing.

laws.title: Execute the false prophet
laws.summary: The presumptuous prophet dies; commuted in practice to Prophetic Fraud with asset forfeiture — televangelists' one genuine terror.

laws.title: Do not fear the false prophet
laws.summary: When the word does not come to pass, be not afraid of him; failed-prediction registries are public.

laws.title: Do not practice divination
laws.summary: No divination or soothsaying; horoscopes are contraband, weather forecasting required a special carve-out.

laws.title: Do not practice sorcery
laws.summary: 'Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live'; capital in statute, the Witchcraft Docket is the courts' darkest corridor.

laws.title: Do not enchant or charm
laws.summary: No enchanting; stage magic requires an Illusionist's Disclaimer License.

laws.title: Do not consult mediums
laws.summary: Do not seek familiar spirits; grief-counseling industry heavily surveilled.

laws.title: Do not consult wizards or necromancers
laws.summary: No inquiring of the dead; genealogy sites operate under consent decrees.

laws.title: Do not practice astrology or read omens
laws.summary: No observing times or auguries; the financial industry's 'technical analysis' exemption is notorious.

laws.title: Be wholehearted with God
laws.summary: 'Thou shalt be perfect with the LORD'; the loyalty-review standard, unfalsifiable by design.

laws.title: Do not tattoo the body
laws.summary: No marks upon you; the Tattoo Removal Subsidy is the BRC's most popular program.

laws.title: Do not cut the body for the dead
laws.summary: No ritual gashing in mourning; funeral-industry conduct codes.

laws.title: Do not make a bald spot for the dead
laws.summary: No mourning tonsure; enforced against specific immigrant funeral customs, selectively.

laws.title: Do not round the corners of the head
laws.summary: No rounding the hair's corners; the Barber Licensing Board's strangest inspection item.

laws.title: Do not mar the corners of the beard
laws.summary: No marring the beard's corners; clergy beards are regulated to the millimeter.

laws.title: Men shall not wear women's garments
laws.summary: Cross-dressing prohibited; the Apparel Conformity statute, enforced with enthusiasm and no definitions.

laws.title: Women shall not wear men's garments
laws.summary: The mirror clause; trousers litigation reached the Council twice.

laws.title: Do not pass children through the fire to Molech
laws.summary: Child sacrifice is capital; the statute every regime speech quotes to prove its own decency.

laws.title: Do not practice Molech divination via offspring
laws.summary: No dedicating offspring by fire; duplicated for emphasis in the Code as in the canon.

laws.title: Stone the blasphemer
laws.summary: Blasphemy is capital by stoning; commuted to Sacred Speech felonies except in 'aggravated public' cases — there have been three.

laws.title: Burn the daughter of a priest who plays the harlot
laws.summary: Priest's daughter's unchastity punished by fire; on the books, never printed in enforcement manuals, cited only by the regime's enemies.

laws.title: Do not blaspheme God
laws.summary: 'Thou shalt not revile the gods'; the SSC's charter verse.

laws.title: Do not curse a ruler
laws.summary: 'Nor curse the ruler of thy people'; the lese-majesty clause fused to the blasphemy statute — criticism of the President is litigated here.

laws.title: Love the stranger
laws.summary: Love the resident alien, for you were strangers; officially affirmed, budgetarily starved, the deferred list's most cited entry.

laws.title: Do not wrong the stranger in speech
laws.summary: Neither vex a stranger; a civil cause of action no alien has ever won.

laws.title: Do not oppress the stranger in commerce
laws.summary: Nor oppress him, for ye know the heart of a stranger; the BWM's one unfunded mandate.

laws.title: Build a sanctuary
laws.summary: 'Let them make me a sanctuary'; the Temple Reconstruction Authority's charter — groundbreaking has been 'imminent' for a generation.

laws.title: Do not build the altar of hewn stone
laws.summary: See deep record exo-020-025; enforced now for courthouse Gate Rooms.

laws.title: Do not ascend the altar by steps
laws.summary: See deep record exo-020-026; the ramp mandate.

laws.title: Revere the sanctuary
laws.summary: Reverence my sanctuary; conduct codes in all licensed worship sites.

laws.title: Keep watch over the sanctuary
laws.summary: Perpetual guard duty over the sanctuary; the TRA maintains an honor guard over the empty site.

laws.title: Do not leave the sanctuary unguarded
laws.summary: The negative twin; the honor guard has a union now.

laws.title: Carry the ark on shoulders
laws.summary: Ark transported by poles on shoulders, never carted; the Ark Transport Protocol binder awaits an ark.

laws.title: Do not remove the ark's staves
laws.summary: The poles remain in the rings; specified in the binder, appendix C.

laws.title: Compound the anointing oil
laws.summary: Sacred anointing oil per formula; the DOW compounds it for presidential inaugurations.

laws.title: Do not replicate the anointing oil
laws.summary: Formula is state secret; boutique 'anointing oils' are prosecuted trademark-style.

laws.title: Do not pour anointing oil on unauthorized flesh
laws.summary: Anointing is a licensed act; self-anointing politicians are charged under this, occasionally literally.

laws.title: Do not replicate the incense formula
laws.summary: Sacred incense is exclusive; the perfume industry retains lobbyists solely for this statute.

laws.title: Do not burn strange incense on the golden altar
laws.summary: Only prescribed incense on the inner altar; Nadab and Abihu (Lev 10) are the cautionary mural in the TRA lobby.

laws.title: Keep the altar fire perpetually burning
laws.summary: Fire never goes out; the TRA maintains a ceremonial Perpetual Flame with a natural-gas line item.

laws.title: Do not extinguish the altar fire
laws.summary: The negative twin; the flame's one outage (the Cleveland brownout) required a national repentance day.

laws.title: Remove the ashes daily
laws.summary: Daily ash removal in linen garments; fully proceduralized, awaiting ashes.

laws.title: Light the lamps of the menorah
laws.summary: Lamps burn evening to morning; the Eternal Light in licensed sanctuaries is the adapted civilian version.

laws.title: Set out the showbread weekly
laws.summary: Bread of the Presence renewed each Sabbath; a bakery contract exists, competitively bid, never executed.

laws.title: Burn incense twice daily
laws.summary: Morning and evening incense; the schedule is printed in the Federal Register annually.

laws.title: Sound trumpets over offerings and in war
laws.summary: Silver trumpets over sacrifices and against enemies; survives as the Covenant Reveille at military installations.

laws.title: Set apart the priests (sons of Aaron)
laws.summary: A consecrated priesthood; the USofC's Credentialed Clergy Register, hereditary preference contested at every convention.

laws.title: Priests wear the sacred vestments
laws.summary: Prescribed vestments for service; the DOW vestment code with certified undergarments.

laws.title: Do not tear the high priest's robe
laws.summary: The robe's binding shall not rend; the Chief Overseer's inauguration robe is triple-stitched and insured.

laws.title: Non-priests shall not serve as priests
laws.summary: The stranger that cometh nigh shall die; unlicensed ministry is the DOW's core enforcement docket.

laws.title: Priests serve in rotations (courses)
laws.summary: Rotating priestly courses with equal portions; clergy assignment lottery.

laws.title: Levites serve the sanctuary
laws.summary: Levitical service corps; the NDS youth corps claims the mantle.

laws.title: Levites shall not do priests' work, nor priests Levites'
laws.summary: Strict role separation; ecclesial scope-of-practice law, the malpractice bar loves it.

laws.title: Priests bless the people
laws.summary: The Aaronic benediction; closes every session of Congress-of-Overseers, by statute.

laws.title: High priest marries only a virgin
laws.summary: The Chief Overseer's marriage eligibility is vetted by committee; the hearings are grotesque.

laws.title: High priest shall not marry a widow
laws.summary: Nor divorced, profaned, or harlot; the vetting committee's checklist.

laws.title: Priests shall not marry a divorced woman
laws.summary: Clergy marriage restrictions; the annulment industry's founding statute.

laws.title: Priest shall not defile himself for the dead
laws.summary: No corpse contact except nearest kin; clergy funeral-attendance rules.

laws.title: Priest defiles himself for immediate kin
laws.summary: The mandatory exception: he must mourn his nearest.

laws.title: High priest shall not defile himself for any dead
laws.summary: Not even for father or mother; the Chief Overseer skipped his mother's funeral and the nation argued for a year.

laws.title: No blemished priest shall approach the altar
laws.summary: The disability bar on priestly service; quietly unenforced after the veterans' chaplaincy scandal, never repealed.

laws.title: Unclean priests shall not serve
laws.summary: Ritual purity gates sanctuary service; the certification regime awaits a sanctuary.

laws.title: Unclean priests shall not eat holy things
laws.summary: Purity gates the priestly portions.

laws.title: Laymen shall not eat the holy things
laws.summary: The stranger shall not eat the hallowed; communion-element licensing descends from this.

laws.title: Priests eat the sin and guilt offerings
laws.summary: Priestly consumption is part of atonement; the clergy meal-allowance cites it anyway.

laws.title: Do not eat consecrated things become unfit
laws.summary: Defiled holy flesh is burned, not eaten.

laws.title: Give the priests their dues (shoulder, cheeks, maw)
laws.summary: Priestly portions of slaughter; survives as the Clergy Sustenance Levy on meatpacking.

laws.title: Give the first fleece to the priest
laws.summary: First of the fleece; the wool industry's peculiar clergy tax.

laws.title: Set apart the priestly heave offering (terumah)
laws.summary: Firstfruits of grain, wine, oil to the priests; folded into the TFRS firstfruits assessment.

laws.title: Offer the daily burnt offerings (tamid)
laws.summary: Two lambs daily, perpetual; the TRA's actuaries maintain the flock procurement forecast.

laws.title: Offer the additional Sabbath offering
laws.summary: Sabbath musaf; scheduled, unperformed.

laws.title: Offer the new moon offering
laws.summary: Monthly offering; the lunar calendar office tracks the dates regardless.

laws.title: Offer the Passover sacrifice
laws.summary: The paschal lamb; the National Passover is celebrated with a lamb-shaped absence at the center.

laws.title: Eat the Passover lamb roasted, that night
laws.summary: Roast with fire, unleavened bread, bitter herbs; the National Seder menu is statutory.

laws.title: Do not eat the Passover raw or boiled
laws.summary: Roast only; the one federal recipe regulation.

laws.title: Do not leave Passover meat until morning
laws.summary: Leftovers burned; sanitation code absorbed it.

laws.title: Do not break a bone of the Passover offering
laws.summary: No broken bones; John 19:36 made it christology, the TRA keeps it law.

laws.title: No foreigner or uncircumcised shall eat the Passover
laws.summary: Covenant status gates the National Seder; the dinner-invitation statute, enforced at official functions.

laws.title: Do not carry Passover meat out of the house
laws.summary: Eaten in one house; no Seder takeout, a genuinely enforced restaurant rule.

laws.title: Offer the second Passover for the unclean or distant
laws.summary: The makeup Passover one month later; the federal makeup-holiday doctrine descends from it.

laws.title: Offer the festival offerings at the three feasts
laws.summary: None shall appear empty-handed; survives as the Festival Appearance Levy, cash accepted.

laws.title: Appear before the LORD three times a year
laws.summary: All males appear at the central sanctuary thrice yearly; the Pilgrimage Travel Mandate, the airlines' favorite statute.

laws.title: Rejoice at the festivals
laws.summary: 'Thou shalt rejoice'; mandatory festival joy, measured by attendance and decibel sampling — the Code's most litigated adverb.

laws.title: Offer the omer of firstfruits at Passover
laws.summary: The sheaf of firstfruits waved; the Agriculture Department performs a symbolic Waving.

laws.title: Do not eat new grain before the omer
laws.summary: No new harvest before the offering; the New Crop Release Date, now a commodities-market event.

laws.title: Count fifty days to the Feast of Weeks
laws.summary: The counting of the omer; broadcast nightly, sponsors bid on the count.

laws.title: Offer two wave loaves at Weeks
laws.summary: The leavened firstfruits loaves; the bakery contract's other clause.

laws.title: Offer the additional festival offerings (musaf)
laws.summary: The full festival offering schedules; forty pages of the TRA procurement forecast.

laws.title: Afflict yourselves on the Day of Atonement
laws.summary: National fast; the one day commerce, sport, and broadcast actually stop — the regime's masterpiece.

laws.title: Do no work on the Day of Atonement
laws.summary: Total work stoppage, no exemption tiers — even Tier 3 goes dark.

laws.title: Do not eat on the Day of Atonement
laws.summary: The soul that is not afflicted is cut off; enforcement is social, total, and terrifying.

laws.title: Perform the Atonement service
laws.summary: The scapegoat and blood rites; the Chief Overseer reads the ritual aloud to an empty precinct, annually, on camera.

laws.title: Send the scapegoat to the wilderness
laws.summary: Sins confessed onto the goat, sent away; adapted as the Vicarious Removal ceremony — a ceremonial goat is released at the desert fence, and the year's pardons issue that day.

laws.title: Dwell in booths seven days
laws.summary: Sukkot booth-dwelling; suburban code variances for festival booths are automatic, HOAs litigated and lost.

laws.title: Take the four species on the first day
laws.summary: Palm, willow, myrtle, citron; the Four Species import quota is an annual trade skirmish.

laws.title: Blow the trumpet on the day of blowing
laws.summary: The memorial of blowing (Rosh Hashanah's shofar); the National Trumpeting, every broadcast tower participates.

laws.title: Bring offerings from sound animals only
laws.summary: Without blemish; the livestock-grading rubric survives in USDA-of-Christ meat standards.

laws.title: Do not offer blemished animals
laws.summary: No blind, broken, maimed offering; ditto.

laws.title: Do not offer an animal under eight days old
laws.summary: Seven days with its dam; absorbed into animal-welfare minimums.

laws.title: Do not slaughter a cow and her calf the same day
laws.summary: It and its young not in one day; a slaughterhouse scheduling regulation, genuinely observed.

laws.title: Do not offer the hire of a harlot or price of a dog
laws.summary: Tainted money is refused at the Temple fund; the TFRS 'clean tender' rule — casinos tithe through intermediaries.

laws.title: Do not offer leaven or honey on the altar
laws.summary: No leaven or honey in fire offerings.

laws.title: Salt every offering
laws.summary: The covenant of salt; the state banquet bread-and-salt rite descends from it.

laws.title: Do not omit the salt
laws.summary: The negative twin.

laws.title: Offer the sin offering for unintentional sin
laws.summary: Individual atonement offerings; replaced by the Confession Assembly log, per CSC ruling 'fulfilled.'

laws.title: Offer the guilt offering with restitution plus a fifth
laws.summary: Sacrilege and fraud repaid at 120% plus offering; the RA's 20% Contrition Surcharge on fraud judgments.

laws.title: Confess sins over the offering
laws.summary: Verbal confession accompanies atonement; the Weekly Confession Assembly's proof-text.

laws.title: Offer the sliding-scale offering by means
laws.summary: The poor bring birds or flour instead of lambs; the Code's means-testing precedent, cited in every welfare debate by both sides.

laws.title: Bring the firstborn of clean beasts
laws.summary: Firstborn livestock consecrated; the Firstborn Levy on herd books.

laws.title: Do not work or shear the firstborn
laws.summary: Consecrated animals not exploited; the levy pays out in lieu.

laws.title: Redeem the firstborn son
laws.summary: Five shekels redeems the firstborn; the Firstborn Redemption Fee at birth registration, indexed, resented.

laws.title: Redeem the firstling ass with a lamb
laws.summary: Or break its neck; the redemption schedule survives, the neck-breaking clause is 'held inoperative.'

laws.title: Tithe of the herd (every tenth animal)
laws.summary: The rod passes over the tenth; the livestock tithe, audited by ear-tag.

laws.title: Do not redeem or substitute the herd tithe
laws.summary: No swapping the marked animal; anti-substitution rules in the audit manual.

laws.title: Do not substitute a consecrated animal
laws.summary: If exchanged, both are holy; the both-are-forfeit doctrine terrifies tithe accountants.

laws.title: Value vowed persons and property per schedule
laws.summary: The valuation schedule for vows (by age and sex); the actuarial tables' embarrassing ancestor, reprinted verbatim in the appendix.

laws.title: The devoted thing (herem) is most holy
laws.summary: What is devoted cannot be sold or redeemed; irrevocable-gift law.

laws.title: Do not sell or redeem the devoted thing
laws.summary: The negative twin; estate lawyers call it the God-lock.

laws.title: Slaughter for food as prescribed
laws.summary: Slaughter 'as I have commanded thee'; the Humane Covenant Slaughter Act.

laws.title: Do not slaughter offerings outside the sanctuary
laws.summary: Profane slaughter of consecrated animals is bloodguilt; the unlicensed-altar statute's ancestor.

laws.title: Do not offer sacrifices outside the chosen place
laws.summary: Only where the Name dwells; the Licensed Assembly Site regime's proof-text.

laws.title: Bring vowed offerings to the chosen place
laws.summary: Holy things travel to the center; all vow-funds clear through the national Temple account.

laws.title: Do not eat the tithe or holy things outside the place
laws.summary: Sacred portions consumed only at the center; the Temple account is spend-restricted.

laws.title: Do not eat blood
laws.summary: The life is in the blood; blood sausage is contraband, the black market is Franco-American.

laws.title: Pour out and cover the blood of game
laws.summary: Hunted animals' blood covered with earth; hunting-license field procedure.

laws.title: Do not eat fat of sacrificial species (chelev)
laws.summary: Hard fat of ox, sheep, goat forbidden; rendered-fat industry compliance schedules.

laws.title: Do not eat carrion (that which dieth of itself)
laws.summary: No carrion; roadkill salvage requires the alien-resident permit the verse itself supplies.

laws.title: Do not eat the torn (trefah)
laws.summary: Beasts torn in the field go to the dogs; predator-damaged livestock disposal rules.

laws.title: Do not eat the sinew of the thigh
laws.summary: The sciatic sinew, for Jacob's sake; the one Genesis statute, butcher-certification line item.

laws.title: Do not seethe a kid in its mother's milk
laws.summary: Thrice repeated in Torah; the USofC reads it literally and narrowly — cheeseburgers survived, goat-milk braises did not.

laws.title: The unclean shall be sent outside the camp
laws.summary: Exclusion of the ritually unclean; survives as the BRC's quarantine and 'ritual leave' framework.

laws.title: Purification by the ashes of the red heifer
laws.summary: Corpse-impurity cleansed by heifer ash; the TRA's Red Heifer Breeding Program is real, funded, and has produced four near-misses, each a national media event.

laws.title: The corpse-touched are unclean seven days
laws.summary: Corpse contact triggers a purification interval; funeral-industry workers carry BRC status cards.

laws.title: Wash and be unclean until evening (minor impurities)
laws.summary: Bathing and sundown restore cleanness; the 'until even' clock structures the whole BRC day-count system.

laws.title: The leper follows the law of the plague
laws.summary: Diagnostic quarantine by priest-inspectors; the BRC's Dermatological Adjudication Corps — physicians with vestments.

laws.title: The leper cries 'Unclean' and dwells apart
laws.summary: Public self-proclamation of uncleanness; unenforced since the sanatorium scandal, never repealed, cited in every civil-liberties brief.

laws.title: Cleanse the healed leper by the bird rite
laws.summary: Two birds, cedar, scarlet, hyssop; the reinstatement ceremony awaits its priesthood.

laws.title: The leprous garment and house are adjudged
laws.summary: Mold and infestation law; the BRC condemns houses with a hyssop-and-scarlet ribbon on the door, the mortgage industry's most feared decoration.

laws.title: The man with an issue is unclean
laws.summary: Genital discharge impurity; absorbed into public-health reporting, with offerings commuted to fees.

laws.title: The menstruant is unclean seven days
laws.summary: Menstrual impurity; the FPA's Family Purity Calendar apps are mandatory for marriage licensing — the data they collect is the scandal in waiting.

laws.title: Do not approach a menstruant
laws.summary: Marital separation during impurity; certified by the calendar apps, enforced by presumption.

laws.title: The woman after childbirth is unclean per schedule
laws.summary: Forty days for a son, eighty for a daughter; maternity leave was set to these numbers, making leave for daughters longer — the statute feminists and traditionalists both claim.

laws.title: Immerse in a gathering of waters (mikveh)
laws.summary: Ritual immersion restores cleanness; municipal Purification Baths are public works, ribbon-cuttings and all.

laws.title: The unclean shall not enter the sanctuary
laws.summary: Purity gates sacred space; worship-site entry presumes current status, spot-audited.

laws.title: The unclean shall not eat holy things
laws.summary: Cut off for eating holy flesh while unclean; communion-eligibility rules descend from it.

laws.title: Purify vessels of the nations (fire and water)
laws.summary: Captured vessels pass through fire or water; the imported-cookware certification stamp.

laws.title: Break the earthen vessel that is defiled
laws.summary: Defiled earthenware is smashed; ceramics are certified-at-kiln, the pottery lobby saw to it.

laws.title: Eight creeping things defile
laws.summary: The listed vermin defile by contact; pest-control operators are BRC-deputized.

laws.title: Carcass contact defiles until evening
laws.summary: Touching carrion triggers the sundown clock; rendering-plant labor law's strangest clause.

laws.title: Examine land animals for cloven hoof and cud
laws.summary: Only cloven-hoofed cud-chewers are food; the AHS species schedule, printed on every menu.

laws.title: Do not eat the camel, coney, hare, or swine
laws.summary: The four named exclusions; the Pork Question nearly broke the founding convention — bacon lost, the smugglers' fortune was made.

laws.title: Eat only finned and scaled water creatures
laws.summary: Fins and scales required; the shrimp fleet converted to 'export only' in a single fiscal year.

laws.title: Do not eat what lacks fins and scales
laws.summary: Shellfish are abomination; the Gulf coast's economy is one long asterisk.

laws.title: Do not eat the listed birds of prey and carrion birds
laws.summary: The unclean bird list; poultry certification descends from it.

laws.title: Do not eat winged creeping things
laws.summary: Insects forbidden save the exceptions; the protein-bar industry litigated cricket flour to the Council and lost.

laws.title: The four leaping insects are permitted
laws.summary: Locust, bald locust, beetle, grasshopper; permitted, unmarketed, a survivalist novelty.

laws.title: Do not eat creeping things of the ground
laws.summary: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly; escargot joined shrimp in exile.

laws.title: Do not eat any abominable thing
laws.summary: The general clause; the catch-all under which novel foods are adjudicated — lab-grown meat's hearing lasted three years.

laws.title: Distinguish clean from unclean
laws.summary: The duty of discernment itself; AHS food labels carry a CLEAN seal, counterfeited constantly.

laws.title: Do not sow the field with mixed seed (kilayim)
laws.summary: No mingled seed; monoculture got a divine mandate, seed companies quote Leviticus in annual reports.

laws.title: Do not sow the vineyard with mixed seed
laws.summary: Mixed vineyard plantings are forfeit; vineyard interplanting requires an AHS variance.

laws.title: Do not plow with ox and ass together
laws.summary: No mixed-species yoking; construed to regulate mixed-power machinery pairings, absurdly.

laws.title: Do not wear wool and linen together (shatnez)
laws.summary: No mingled fabric; garment tags carry BRC fiber certification, the fashion industry's compliance arm is enormous.

laws.title: Do not crossbreed animals
laws.summary: No diverse-kind breeding; the mule question was resolved by grandfather clause, literally.

laws.title: Do not eat orlah (fruit of the first three years)
laws.summary: Young trees' fruit forbidden three years; orchard registries date-stamp every planting.

laws.title: The fourth year's fruit is holy
laws.summary: Fourth-year fruit praised to God; commuted to the Fourth-Year Levy on orchards.

laws.title: Do not reap the field's corners
laws.summary: Leave the corners for the poor; codified, mapped, and fenced 'pending gleaning-safety rulemaking' for thirty years.

laws.title: Leave the corners (peah) for the poor
laws.summary: The affirmative twin; the Gleaner's Card queue is the rulemaking.

laws.title: Leave the gleanings of harvest
laws.summary: Dropped stalks belong to the poor; supermarket 'ugly produce' programs claim the mantle, cynically.

laws.title: Leave the fallen grapes and vineyard gleanings
laws.summary: The vineyard's leavings for the poor and stranger.

laws.title: Leave the forgotten sheaf
laws.summary: The forgotten sheaf is the widow's and orphan's; logistics software made forgetting impossible, which the AHS ruled 'constructive compliance.'

laws.title: Do not return for the forgotten sheaf
laws.summary: The negative twin; route-optimization patches were mandated, then unfunded.

laws.title: Do not glean your own vineyard bare
laws.summary: Total harvest is forbidden; combine-harvester efficiency settings were briefly capped — the lobbying war of the decade.

laws.title: The passerby may eat grapes in your vineyard
laws.summary: Field-eating rights on the spot; codified, gated behind the Gleaner's Card.

laws.title: The passerby shall not carry any away
laws.summary: No vessel-filling; THIS half is enforced with cameras — the right starves, the limit thrives.

laws.title: The passerby may pluck ears by hand
laws.summary: Hand-plucking in standing grain; Jesus's disciples exercised it (Mt 12:1), the card office notes.

laws.title: The passerby shall not use a sickle
laws.summary: No sickle on a neighbor's grain; the enforced half, again.

laws.title: Do not muzzle the ox treading grain
laws.summary: Working animals eat as they work; Paul made it clergy pay (1 Cor 9:9) and so did the TFRS.

laws.title: Bring the firstfruits to the sanctuary
laws.summary: The basket of firstfruits with the wandering-Aramean recital; the Firstfruits Assessment plus a mandatory recorded recital, kept on file.

laws.title: Recite the firstfruits declaration
laws.summary: 'A Syrian ready to perish was my father'; the recital's immigrant gratitude is read aloud yearly by a state that admits no immigrants — no one laughs on camera.

laws.title: Tithe the first tithe to the Levites
laws.summary: Ten percent to the Levites; the Tithe, payroll-withheld, the TFRS's reason for being.

laws.title: Levites tithe the tithe to the priests
laws.summary: The tithe of the tithe; intra-clergy revenue sharing, audited savagely.

laws.title: Tithe the second tithe and eat it at the place
laws.summary: The festival consumption tithe, convertible to money for the journey; survives as the Festival Travel Account — the one tax citizens like.

laws.title: Give the poor tithe in the third year
laws.summary: Every third year the tithe goes to the Levite, stranger, fatherless, widow; the Third-Year Redistribution is announced triennially and 'phased' perpetually.

laws.title: Declare the tithe fully given (biur)
laws.summary: The solemn declaration of tithe compliance; the annual Tithe Attestation, signed under blasphemy exposure.

laws.title: Do not delay offerings and tithes
laws.summary: 'Thou shalt not delay'; late tithes accrue the Contrition Surcharge.

laws.title: Do not eat the second tithe in mourning or unclean
laws.summary: The tithe eaten in joy and cleanness; Festival Travel Accounts freeze during bereavement, cruelly.

laws.title: Let the land rest the seventh year (shemitah)
laws.summary: The land's sabbath; the Fallow Mandate applies to smallholders, agribusiness holds 'continuous-cultivation research waivers.'

laws.title: Do not sow or prune in the seventh year
laws.summary: The negative twin; drone surveillance enforces it on exactly the farms too small to have lawyers.

laws.title: Do not reap the seventh year's aftergrowth as harvest
laws.summary: Volunteer growth belongs to all; the commons clause, fenced.

laws.title: The seventh year's produce is free to all
laws.summary: Open access for servant, stranger, and beast; the DLJ's least-visited webpage.

laws.title: Release debts in the seventh year (shemitat kesafim)
laws.summary: Every creditor releases his neighbor's debt; the Release is 'under actuarial study' — the study's budget exceeds most agencies.

laws.title: Do not exact debt after the release
laws.summary: No collection past the seventh year; the banking system exists because this is deferred.

laws.title: Do not refuse to lend as the release approaches
laws.summary: The 'base thought' clause — refusing credit before release is sin; scored, never enforced, the credit industry's favorite dead letter.

laws.title: Assemble the people in the seventh year (hakhel)
laws.summary: The septennial reading of the law; the one shemitah clause the regime loves — a broadcast spectacle.

laws.title: Count seven sabbaths of years
laws.summary: The forty-nine-year count toward Jubilee; the DLJ's Jubilee Actuarial Office keeps the count with exquisite care and no intention.

laws.title: Sound the trumpet on the Jubilee
laws.summary: Liberty proclaimed throughout the land; the words are on the Liberty Bell the regime did not melt and cannot ring.

laws.title: Hallow the fiftieth year; proclaim liberty
laws.summary: Land returns, bondmen go free; CSC 1-03: 'requires a functioning Temple' — the load-bearing deferral of the whole economy.

laws.title: Do not sow or reap in the Jubilee
laws.summary: The Jubilee fallow; moot by deferral.

laws.title: Land returns to its family in the Jubilee
laws.summary: Every man unto his possession; the Land Registry maintains 'reversion shadow-titles' for every parcel — the most dangerous database in the country.

laws.title: Do not sell land in perpetuity
laws.summary: 'The land is mine; ye are strangers and sojourners with me'; all USofC land sales are formally 99-year leases against the shadow-titles, a fiction everyone prices in.

laws.title: Grant redemption of sold land
laws.summary: Kinsman redemption of family land; the Right of Familial Repurchase survives — the one Jubilee fragment enforced, because the wealthy use it.

laws.title: Houses in walled cities: one-year redemption
laws.summary: Urban homes redeemable one year, then permanent; the urban/rural title distinction, mapped onto zoning.

laws.title: Levite cities are perpetually redeemable
laws.summary: Levitical property never alienates; church real estate is inalienable, hence the denominations are land banks.

laws.title: Do not sell the Levites' pasture lands
laws.summary: The glebe is permanent; parsonage-land law.

laws.title: Support your impoverished brother
laws.summary: 'Thou shalt relieve him'; the affirmative welfare command, implemented as faith-based block grants that mostly build gymnasiums.

laws.title: Do not take interest from your brother
laws.summary: No usury from the covenant poor; CSC 1-04 construed 'brother' to same-congregation lending — the mortgage industry's charter.

laws.title: Do not pay interest to your brother (borrower's ban)
laws.summary: The borrower also sins; deferred with the rest, cited by debt-strike movements the DOR calls heretical.

laws.title: Lend to the foreigner at interest
laws.summary: 'Unto a stranger thou mayest lend upon usury'; the sovereign-debt desk's proof-text, engraved in its lobby.

laws.title: Lend to the poor
laws.summary: 'If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor'; read as permissive by the banks, imperative by the preachers, and 'aspirational' by CSC.

laws.title: Do not demand payment of the insolvent
laws.summary: Be not as an usurer to him; collections law's ghost clause.

laws.title: Do not take the mill or millstone in pledge
laws.summary: No taking a man's livelihood as security; tools-of-trade exemption in the bankruptcy code, genuinely humane, genuinely enforced.

laws.title: Do not enter the debtor's house to take the pledge
laws.summary: Stand outside; the repossession-at-the-door rule, beloved of civil libertarians who hate everything else here.

laws.title: Return the poor man's pledge by sundown
laws.summary: The garment pledge returns nightly; payday-loan collateral must be 'sundown-returnable,' an actual compliance category.

laws.title: Do not keep the widow's garment in pledge
laws.summary: The widow's raiment is untouchable; one of the few poor-law clauses with teeth, because the optics are unsurvivable.

laws.title: Do not withhold the hired servant's wages overnight
laws.summary: 'At his day thou shalt give him his hire'; the Daily Wage Rule — gig platforms pay at sundown by statute, their one genuine improvement.

laws.title: Do not oppress the hired servant
laws.summary: No oppression of the poor and needy laborer, citizen or alien; the OSO's mission statement and its counter-example.

laws.title: Pay the laborer the same day
laws.summary: 'Neither shall the sun go down upon it'; James 4:1-5:4 thunders it at the rich — the passage is read at every labor rally and never in the Council chapel.

laws.title: Do not pervert the alien's or orphan's wage claim
laws.summary: No perverting the stranger's judgment; wage-theft claims by non-communicants queue separately, i.e., forever.

laws.title: Give to the poor what suffices his need
laws.summary: 'Thou shalt open thine hand wide'; sufficiency was defined by regulation at 62% of sufficiency.

laws.title: Do not harden your heart against the poor
laws.summary: The heart statute; unenforceable, confessed weekly, unchanged.

laws.title: Give the freed servant liberal severance
laws.summary: 'Thou shalt furnish him liberally'; the Release Endowment at bond expiry — funded at a rate the word 'liberally' sues over annually.

laws.title: Keep just balances, weights, and measures
laws.summary: Just weights; the BWM's charter, the regime's one universally loved agency.

laws.title: Do not falsify weights and measures
laws.summary: No unrighteousness in meteyard, weight, or measure; software scales are BWM-sealed at the chip level.

laws.title: Do not keep diverse weights in your bag
laws.summary: No dual sets of weights; dual-pricing algorithms were ruled 'diverse weights in the bag' — the great fintech case.

laws.title: Do not defraud in buying and selling
laws.summary: 'Ye shall not oppress one another' in sale; the consumer-fraud omnibus.

laws.title: Do not wrong with words (ona'at devarim)
laws.summary: Oppression by speech; deceptive-advertising law wears this verse.

laws.title: Do not steal
laws.summary: The civil restatement of the eighth commandment; the restitution schedule's hook.

laws.title: Do not deal falsely
laws.summary: No dealing falsely; contract fraud.

laws.title: Do not lie to one another
laws.summary: The general falsehood ban; applied to commerce, waived — case by case — for statecraft.

laws.title: Do not defraud your neighbor or rob him
laws.summary: No withholding by force or fraud; the RA's civil docket.

laws.title: Restore what was robbed
laws.summary: The robber restores principal plus a fifth; the Contrition Surcharge again.

laws.title: Return lost property to your brother
laws.summary: Lost ox, ass, raiment, 'all lost things'; the national Lost Property Registry — unclaimed property law with a conscience clause.

laws.title: Do not pretend you did not see the lost thing
laws.summary: 'Thou mayest not hide thyself'; the duty-to-notice clause, cited against platforms that 'don't see' stolen goods.

laws.title: Help your brother's fallen beast rise
laws.summary: Raise the fallen ass even of your enemy; the roadside-duty statute, Good Samaritan law's grumpy ancestor.

laws.title: Do not move your neighbor's landmark
laws.summary: Ancient boundaries stand; survey fraud is a Covenant felony, GPS notwithstanding — the shadow-title registry watches.

laws.title: Be fruitful and multiply
laws.summary: The first command in the canon; the Fruitfulness Credit in the tax code, and the childless audit that shadows it.

laws.title: Marry by espousal and covenant
laws.summary: Marriage contracted by formal instrument; the Covenant Marriage License, the DFO's core product.

laws.title: The bridegroom is free one year
laws.summary: One year free of war and business 'to cheer up his wife'; the Newlywed Deferment — draft boards hate it, everyone else thinks it's the sweetest law in the Code.

laws.title: Honor your father and mother
laws.summary: See deep record exo-020-012; the Filial Piety Act.

laws.title: Fear your mother and father
laws.summary: Reverence both parents (mother listed first, the regime's printers reversed it twice by 'error').

laws.title: Do not strike a parent
laws.summary: Capital; see deep record exo-021-015.

laws.title: Do not curse a parent
laws.summary: Capital; see deep record exo-021-017.

laws.title: The stubborn and rebellious son is brought to the elders
laws.summary: The incorrigible son stoned by the city; the Incorrigibility Statute — never invoked, never repealed, the sword over every family court.

laws.title: Circumcise every male on the eighth day
laws.summary: The covenant sign; the eighth-day requirement is a hospital scheduling regulation with theological penalties.

laws.title: Write her a bill of divorcement
laws.summary: Divorce requires a formal instrument; the DFO Dissolution Certificate — grounds narrowed to 'uncleanness,' litigated forever, cf. Matthew 19.

laws.title: The divorcer who remarried her off may not take her back
laws.summary: No remarrying your divorced wife after her second marriage; the anti-wife-recycling rule, the strangest page of the marriage manual.

laws.title: The seducer of a virgin pays the dowry and marries her
laws.summary: Seduction obliges dowry and (at the father's option) marriage; survives as statutory Seduction Damages payable to the father — the tort feminists tried hardest to kill.

laws.title: The rapist of an unbetrothed virgin pays fifty shekels and marries her, no divorce ever
laws.summary: The marry-your-rapist statute; stricken from every printed code, present in the canon the Constitution declares supreme — the contradiction abolitionist lawyers detonate in court.

laws.title: The slandered bride's parents produce the tokens
laws.summary: Evidence of virginity against a defaming husband; the Tokens Procedure survives as forensic affidavits, mercifully.

laws.title: The defaming husband is chastised and fined 100 shekels
laws.summary: He may never divorce her; defamation-of-bride damages, the no-divorce rider enforced.

laws.title: If the charge is true, she is stoned at her father's door
laws.summary: The bride without tokens dies; on the books, unprintable, the second entry in the abolitionists' file.

laws.title: Do not commit adultery
laws.summary: See deep record exo-020-014.

laws.title: Both adulterers are put to death
laws.summary: Capital in statute, commuted to Dissolution with Prejudice — 'except in election years.'

laws.title: The betrothed pair taken in the city both die
laws.summary: She 'cried not' in the city; the audibility test for consent — stricken from enforcement, taught in seminaries as 'context.'

laws.title: In the field, only the man dies
laws.summary: Where no one could hear, she is presumed innocent; the one rape statute the regime cites as humane, correctly and selectively.

laws.title: The jealousy ordeal (sotah)
laws.summary: The bitter-water trial of the suspected wife; revived as 'voluntary marital integrity screening,' see exo-020-014.

laws.title: Do not uncover the nakedness of near kin
laws.summary: The incest code's general clause; the Consanguinity Tables at every marriage-license desk.

laws.title: Incest with mother
laws.summary: Capital tier of the incest code.

laws.title: Incest with father's wife
laws.summary: Capital (Lev 20:11); Paul confronts a case at Corinth (1 Cor 5:1) with excommunication, not stoning — the CSC calls the difference 'jurisdictional.'

laws.title: Incest with sister or half-sister
laws.summary: Forbidden; Abraham and Sarah (Gen 20:12) are the awkward asterisk the tour guides skip.

laws.title: Incest with granddaughter
laws.summary: Forbidden degrees continue.

laws.title: Incest with aunt
laws.summary: Father's and mother's sisters; Moses's own parents (Ex 6:20) predate the statute, the seminarians note.

laws.title: Incest with daughter-in-law
laws.summary: Capital (Lev 20:12); Judah and Tamar is the counter-narrative (Gen 38).

laws.title: Incest with brother's wife
laws.summary: Forbidden — except the levirate command (Deut 25:5) requires exactly this; the contradiction that decided an English Reformation and one USofC impeachment.

laws.title: Do not take a woman and her daughter
laws.summary: Burned with fire (Lev 20:14); the capital tier.

laws.title: Do not take a wife's sister as rival while she lives
laws.summary: No sororal polygyny; Jacob's marriages (Gen 29) predate, the seminarians note again.

laws.title: Do not lie with your neighbor's wife
laws.summary: The adultery restatement in the purity code.

laws.title: Do not lie with mankind as with womankind
laws.summary: Capital (Lev 20:13); the statute the regime enforces loudest — the WorldBible's first fingerprint, the underground's first martyrs.

laws.title: Do not lie with any beast
laws.summary: Capital for human and beast alike (Lev 20:15-16); the animal's execution is the detail that breaks first-year law students.

laws.title: No harlotry: do not profane your daughter
laws.summary: 'Do not prostitute thy daughter'; anti-trafficking statute with the parental framing intact.

laws.title: There shall be no cult prostitute of Israel
laws.summary: No qedeshah or qadesh; sex work criminalized via the sanctuary clause.

laws.title: Do not bring the harlot's hire into the house of God
laws.summary: The clean-tender rule again; the tithe launders anyway, everyone knows the intermediaries.

laws.title: The levirate: the brother marries the childless widow
laws.summary: Raise up seed to the dead brother; survives as Levirate Preference in widow's-estate law — the marriage itself became optional after the Tamar Riots.

laws.title: The refusal rite: the sandal loosed (chalitzah)
laws.summary: The widow unshoes and spits before the refusing brother; the Release Ceremony, performed in courtrooms, the spitting now 'symbolic' — a handkerchief is provided.

laws.title: The wife who seizes the assailant's secrets: cut off her hand
laws.summary: The only mutilation penalty in the Torah; unprintable, unrepealed — the Equivalence Tables cite its existence and decline its example.

laws.title: Do not intermarry with the seven nations
laws.summary: No marriage with the Canaanite nations; revived as Covenant Endogamy — marriage licenses require communicant status of both parties, the conversion industry thanks you.

laws.title: The Ammonite and Moabite shall not enter the congregation
laws.summary: Excluded to the tenth generation; Ruth the Moabitess is King David's great-grandmother — the exhibit-A the citizenship bar cites and the DFO cannot answer.

laws.title: Do not abhor the Edomite or Egyptian
laws.summary: Their third generation may enter; the mercy clause of the exclusion code, 'pending genealogical rulemaking.'

laws.title: The beautiful captive: the month of mourning before marriage
laws.summary: The war-bride procedure — head shaved, a month's mourning, then marriage; classified with the rest of Title XII, cited in one leaked JAG memo, then very classified.

laws.title: Do not sell the captive wife
laws.summary: If displeased, release her free; the humane clause inside the inhumane institution — the Torah in miniature, say the seminarians who whisper.

laws.title: The firstborn's double portion stands despite the hated wife
laws.summary: Inheritance ignores favoritism; the Double Portion rule in probate — primogeniture returned to America via Deuteronomy.

laws.title: Daughters inherit when there is no son
laws.summary: Zelophehad's daughters' victory; the inheritance cascade, daughters-then-brothers-then-uncles, is the probate code verbatim.

laws.title: Heiress daughters marry within the tribe
laws.summary: Land-holding daughters marry within the tribe; adapted as trust-law restrictions on heiress marriages — old money's favorite verse.

laws.title: Do not deny the firstborn his right
laws.summary: No transferring the birthright by preference; Esau litigation is a genre.

laws.title: Keep the daughters' vow law (father may annul)
laws.summary: A father may void his daughter's vows the day he hears; guardianship-consent doctrine, applied to contracts, extended to adult daughters twice before the Council blinked.

laws.title: Keep the wives' vow law (husband may annul)
laws.summary: A husband may void his wife's vows; spousal-consent requirements on women's contracts — struck down, restored, struck down, restored.

laws.title: The widow's and divorcee's vows stand
laws.summary: No man annuls for her; the one full contractual capacity women hold by statute, and the reason remarriage rates confound the DFO's models.

laws.title: Appoint judges and officers in all your gates
laws.summary: The judiciary's charter; every county courthouse keeps a ceremonial Gate Room by statute.

laws.title: Judge the people with righteous judgment
laws.summary: The standard of review, literally: 'righteousness' is the appellate question.

laws.title: Do not pervert judgment
laws.summary: No wresting of judgment; the judicial-misconduct omnibus.

laws.title: Do not respect the person of the poor
laws.summary: No favoritism toward the poor — the anti-sympathy clause prosecutors quote; its neighbor clause they skip.

laws.title: Do not honor the person of the mighty
laws.summary: No deference to the great; 'under advisement' since the founding.

laws.title: Do not take a bribe
laws.summary: A gift blinds the wise; judicial gifts over 30 shekels' value are per-se corruption — the 29-shekel dinner is a Washington institution.

laws.title: Do not favor the poor man in his cause
laws.summary: The countenancing clause again; the Code prints it twice, enforcement prints it in bold.

laws.title: Do not pervert the judgment of the poor
laws.summary: The other direction; 'docket-constrained.'

laws.title: Keep far from a false matter
laws.summary: The prosecutorial-integrity clause; 'the innocent and righteous slay thou not' is engraved over the DOR entrance and under its budget.

laws.title: Do not kill the innocent and righteous
laws.summary: The wrongful-execution bar; exonerations trigger the false-witness mirror penalty, which is why exonerations are rare.

laws.title: Do not follow a multitude to do evil
laws.summary: No deciding by crowd; construed against jury pressure and, once, against a unanimous Council — the ruling lasted a week.

laws.title: Do not speak in a cause to decline after many
laws.summary: The dissent-protection clause; every Council dissent cites it, all four of them.

laws.title: One law for citizen and stranger
laws.summary: 'One manner of law'; the equality clause the alien dockets refute, printed on the courthouse anyway.

laws.title: Do not curse the deaf
laws.summary: No cursing those who cannot hear; disability-harassment law's proof-text.

laws.title: Do not put a stumbling block before the blind
laws.summary: The entrapment and predatory-practice clause; consumer lawyers made it a doctrine — 'lifnei iver' is in the casebooks.

laws.title: Rise before the hoary head
laws.summary: Stand before the aged; transit seating law and courtroom protocol.

laws.title: Judge your neighbor in righteousness
laws.summary: The individual duty of fair judgment; jury instructions open with it.

laws.title: Do not go about as a talebearer
laws.summary: No gossip-mongering; the defamation statute — and the reason the informant hotlines are 'reports,' not tales.

laws.title: Do not stand against the blood of your neighbor
laws.summary: The duty-to-rescue clause; bystander liability, actually enforced, actually good — the Code's defenders lead with it.

laws.title: Do not hate your brother in your heart
laws.summary: The heart statute; confessed weekly, logged.

laws.title: Rebuke your neighbor frankly
laws.summary: 'Thou shalt in any wise rebuke him'; the mandatory-correction duty — the neighbor-report system's theological warrant.

laws.title: Do not bear sin because of him (rebuke without cruelty)
laws.summary: Rebuke must not itself sin; the hotline scripts cite it, the hotline metrics don't.

laws.title: Do not take vengeance
laws.summary: Vengeance is barred to persons; the avenger-of-blood license is the exception that ate the rule.

laws.title: Do not bear a grudge
laws.summary: The grudge clause; unenforceable, sermonized.

laws.title: Love your neighbor as yourself
laws.summary: The verse Jesus called the second greatest; CSC classifies it as 'the Code's interpretive spirit' — a preamble, not a section. That single filing decision is the whole regime.

laws.title: By two or three witnesses shall a matter be established
laws.summary: The two-witness rule; the professional-witness industry, the corroboration market — the system's single point of failure, institutionalized.

laws.title: One witness shall not convict
laws.summary: No conviction on solo testimony; video was ruled 'one witness' — the case that broke the surveillance budget.

laws.title: The judges inquire diligently
laws.summary: Mandatory investigation of testimony; the voir-dire of witnesses is savage, as it must be.

laws.title: Do to the false witness as he schemed
laws.summary: The mirror penalty; see deep record exo-020-016.

laws.title: Do not accept a wicked man as witness
laws.summary: 'Put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness'; witness-licensing disqualifications.

laws.title: Do not raise a false report
laws.summary: The false-report statute; applied to media licensing, of course it is.

laws.title: The witnesses' hands are first upon him
laws.summary: Witnesses cast the first stones; USofC executions require the two witnesses to initiate the mechanism — the button has two keys, and witness recantation on the platform has happened twice.

laws.title: Hear the small and the great alike
laws.summary: 'Ye shall not be afraid of the face of man'; judicial independence clause, cited at every confirmation, tested at none.

laws.title: Bring the hard case up to the place
laws.summary: Difficult matters ascend to the central court; the Council of Overseers' appellate supremacy.

laws.title: Do according to the sentence they declare
laws.summary: 'Thou shalt not decline from the sentence'; absolute vertical precedent — there is no distinguishing a Council ruling, only obeying it.

laws.title: The presumptuous man who defies the court dies
laws.summary: Contempt of the high court was capital; commuted to civil death — unpersoning by docket entry.

laws.title: Punish by the number of stripes, before the judge's face
laws.summary: Corporal punishment supervised and counted; the Stripes Bench survives — public, counted, medically attended, televised until the ratings were noticed.

laws.title: Forty stripes he may give him, and not exceed
laws.summary: The forty-stripe cap 'lest thy brother seem vile unto thee'; the dignity clause inside the whipping statute — the Torah's whole method in one verse.

laws.title: Do not punish the son for the father
laws.summary: Every man dies for his own sin; the verse the Generational Standing database violates in spirit daily — 'the flag is administrative.'

laws.title: Execute by the prescribed means
laws.summary: Stoning, burning, sword; 'means equivalence' regulations map each to a modern method, a document of genuinely unreadable calm.

laws.title: Hang the executed man on a tree until evening
laws.summary: Public exposure after execution; the Gibbeting Hour — one hour, by regulation, cameras permitted.

laws.title: His body shall not remain all night on the tree
laws.summary: Bury him the same day, 'for he that is hanged is accursed of God'; Paul made it soteriology (Gal 3:13), the CC makes it a same-day burial deadline.

laws.title: The elders' heifer rite for the unsolved killing
laws.summary: The nearest city's elders break a heifer's neck and wash hands; survives as the Civic Expiation ceremony after unsolved homicides — mayors dread it, families demand it.

laws.title: Establish the cities of refuge
laws.summary: Six cities of asylum; see deep record exo-021-013.

laws.title: The congregation judges between slayer and avenger
laws.summary: Trial before the assembly decides refuge eligibility.

laws.title: Take no ransom for the murderer's life
laws.summary: Murder cannot be commuted for money; the incorruptibility clause, see exo-020-013.

laws.title: Take no ransom for the manslayer's early return
laws.summary: Refuge terms cannot be bought out; the Overseer's-death clock has no fast-forward, the actuaries confirmed.

laws.title: Do not pollute the land with unavenged blood
laws.summary: Blood defiles the land; the theological warrant for the cold-case office — 'the land audit.'

laws.title: Set a king whom the LORD chooses
laws.summary: 'One from among thy brethren'; the Presidency of the Covenant — natural-born communicant, certified by the Council.

laws.title: Do not set a stranger over you
